description_en: Starts an alert rule by calling the StartAlert operation
description_zh: 调用StartAlert接口启动报警规则
name: StartAlert

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert rule. You can call the SearchAlertRules operation to query alert rule IDs. The value corresponds to the Id response parameter. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/175825.html
parameters.help_zh: 报警规则ID，可调用SearchAlertRules接口查询，对应返回参数`Id`，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/175825.html
parameters.name: alert_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Set the value to `cn-hangzhou`
parameters.name: region_id

IsSuccess.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

`true`: The operation was successful.
`false`: The operation failed
IsSuccess.description_zh:
操作是否成功：

`true`：操作成功
`false`：操作失败
